TCF: Geometry Control File.description: TCF (.tcf): reference a geometry control file

TCF: BC Control File.description: TCF (.tcf): reference a boundary control file

TCF: End Time.description: TCF (.tcf): set the simulation end time in hours

TGC: Cell Size.description: TGC (.tgc): set the 2D grid cell size

TGC: Read GIS Z Shape.description: TGC (.tgc): read a vector 2d_zsh elevation-modification layer

ECF: Read GIS Network.description: ECF (.ecf): read a 1d_nwk vector network layer

QCF: Base Cell Size.description: QCF (.qcf): set the quadtree parent cell size

TRFC: RF Interpolation Method.description: TRFC (.trfc): choose a documented rainfall interpolation method

TEF: Define Event block.description: TEF (.tef): define an event block with an end-time override
